classes.name: Basic Tank
classes.description: One cannon. Move, aim and shoot.
classes.strengths: Accurate, efficient shots; forgiving movement.
classes.weaknesses: No defensive ability or specialized burst damage.

classes.name: Twin
classes.description: Two parallel cannons fire alternating bullets.
classes.strengths: Steady forward fire through two lanes.
classes.weaknesses: Individual shots have limited damage.

classes.name: Sniper
classes.description: Long range piercing shots. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Long-range shots pass through several soft targets.
classes.weaknesses: Reloading exposes it to sudden rushes.

classes.name: Machine Gun
classes.description: A wide cannon fires short bursts of bullets.
classes.strengths: Fast repeatable volleys and reliable polygon farming.
classes.weaknesses: Less burst damage per individual projectile.

classes.name: Flank Guard
classes.description: A front cannon and a shorter rear cannon.
classes.strengths: Rear fire helps while retreating.
classes.weaknesses: Only one cannon points toward your aim.

classes.name: Overseer
classes.description: Two opposing drone launchers. Aim to attack; right click to recall.
classes.strengths: Drones follow targets beyond the firing direction.
classes.weaknesses: Deployment takes time and drones can be destroyed.

classes.name: Trapper
classes.description: A flared cannon launches traps.
classes.strengths: Traps defend a position and slow pursuit.
classes.weaknesses: Poor reach and slow setup.

classes.name: Smasher
classes.description: An armored tank that fights with body damage.
classes.strengths: Strong contact damage and a dash.
classes.weaknesses: No guns; needs close contact.

classes.name: Destroyer
classes.description: A large cannon fires heavy shells.
classes.strengths: Strong individual shots.
classes.weaknesses: Slow fire and heavy recoil.

classes.name: Triple Shot
classes.description: Three alternating cannons fire in a forward fan.
classes.strengths: The fan catches enemies moving sideways.
classes.weaknesses: Outer shots cannot focus on one distant target.

classes.name: Twin Flank
classes.description: Two forward cannons and two rear cannons.
classes.strengths: Front bursts and rear fire cover a retreat.
classes.weaknesses: Forward cannons pause between bursts.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: One forward cannon, two side cannons and two rear thrusters.
classes.strengths: Fire covers the sides and rear; Dash helps reposition.
classes.weaknesses: Most cannons point away from the cursor.

classes.name: Hunter
classes.description: Two stacked cannons. Hold fire for repeated long-range shots.
classes.strengths: A piercing rifle with a faster forward cannon.
classes.weaknesses: The rifle reloads slowly.

classes.name: Stalker
classes.description: A long guided cannon with a Blink ability. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Guided shots and Blink help reposition.
classes.weaknesses: Walls and enemy shots can stop the rounds.

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: A long cannon fires bursts of piercing shots.
classes.strengths: Shots can pass through several targets.
classes.weaknesses: Narrow shots require accurate aim.

classes.name: Spread Shot
classes.description: Eleven cannons spread bullets across a wide forward arc.
classes.strengths: Covers a wide area in front of the tank.
classes.weaknesses: Limited concentrated damage at long range.

classes.name: Sprayer
classes.description: A wide scatter cannon with a longer bullet cannon.
classes.strengths: Strong forward coverage at close range.
classes.weaknesses: Scatter shots are less effective at long range.

classes.name: Blaster
classes.description: A wide scatter cannon with an area attack ability.
classes.strengths: Strong close-range coverage.
classes.weaknesses: Short reach and pauses between attacks.

classes.name: Quad Tank
classes.description: Four cannons point in different directions.
classes.strengths: Covers four directions and has a shield ability.
classes.weaknesses: Damage is split between firing directions.

classes.name: Octo Tank
classes.description: Eight cannons fire around the tank.
classes.strengths: Good close-range coverage.
classes.weaknesses: Most guns cannot hit the same distant target.

classes.name: Rear Booster
classes.description: A forward shell cannon and a rear scatter cannon.
classes.strengths: Rear recoil helps move while firing.
classes.weaknesses: Opposing cannons require careful movement.

classes.name: Overlord
classes.description: Four drone launchers. Aim to attack; right click to recall.
classes.strengths: Drones can attack from several directions.
classes.weaknesses: A lost formation takes time to rebuild.

classes.name: Sentinel
classes.description: 1 drone launcher and 1 barrier launcher. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Combines autonomous units with a durable defensive screen.
classes.weaknesses: Slow to redeploy after giving up ground.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: Six little tanks follow your cursor and fire their own guns. Right click brings them back.
classes.strengths: A tough firing line you can move around instead of leaving it behind.
classes.weaknesses: Only six minions. Losing the whole squad leaves you exposed while it rebuilds.

classes.name: Barricader
classes.description: 1 trap launcher.
classes.strengths: Creates broad, durable approach denial.
classes.weaknesses: Weak against enemies who refuse to approach its traps.

classes.name: Landmine
classes.description: An armored rammer with a double hexagonal base and magnet ability.
classes.strengths: Strong body damage and fast health recovery.
classes.weaknesses: No guns; enemies can keep their distance.

classes.name: Auto Trapper
classes.description: A trap launcher with an automatic turret. Heal nearby allies.
classes.strengths: Traps and allied healing help hold a position.
classes.weaknesses: Limited damage while chasing enemies.

classes.name: Spike
classes.description: A spiked rammer with a dash and steady health recovery.
classes.strengths: Strong body damage and a dash to close distance.
classes.weaknesses: Needs close contact to deal damage.

classes.name: Mega Smasher
classes.description: A larger rammer with a shield ability.
classes.strengths: High health and strong body damage.
classes.weaknesses: Slow movement and no guns.

classes.name: Rocketeer
classes.description: An explosive cannon with a Blink ability. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Explosions damage groups; Blink helps reposition.
classes.weaknesses: Reloading leaves less time to react at close range.

classes.name: Annihilator
classes.description: A wide cannon fires explosive shells.
classes.strengths: Heavy shots damage nearby targets on impact.
classes.weaknesses: Slow shells are easier to dodge.

classes.name: Mortar
classes.description: 1 fragment cannon. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Fragment spread reaches beyond the primary impact.
classes.weaknesses: Reload time and slow movement expose it to flanking.

classes.name: Twin Destroyer
classes.description: 2 shell cannons.
classes.strengths: Heavy sustained cadence rather than one long recovery.
classes.weaknesses: Wide mounts and heavy recoil complicate tight positioning.

classes.name: Penta Shot
classes.description: Five alternating cannons fire in a wide forward fan.
classes.strengths: Wide forward coverage with a shield ability.
classes.weaknesses: Outer guns cannot focus on one distant target.

classes.name: Predator
classes.description: Three stacked cannons fire bursts of piercing shots.
classes.strengths: Concentrated bursts can penetrate several targets.
classes.weaknesses: Pauses between bursts leave openings.

classes.name: Cyclone Gunner
classes.description: 3 bullet cannons. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Reliable rear defense and sustained staggered burst pressure.
classes.weaknesses: Its firing rhythm gives observant opponents predictable openings.

classes.name: Switchback
classes.description: 2 bullet cannons and 2 trap launchers.
classes.strengths: Lateral denial and sudden repositioning during burst recovery.
classes.weaknesses: Trap timing and blink distance need careful control.

classes.name: Skimmer
classes.description: A wide cannon combines bullet and scatter volleys.
classes.strengths: Two shot types cover different distances.
classes.weaknesses: A missed volley leaves time for an enemy to approach.

classes.name: Wake
classes.description: 2 bullet cannons and 1 mine layer.
classes.strengths: Controls pursuit lanes while sustaining forward fire.
classes.weaknesses: Mine trails are strongest after opponents commit to chasing.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A long rifle with piercing shots and guided follow-up shots.
classes.strengths: Long reach and guided forward support.
classes.weaknesses: The main shot reloads slowly.

classes.name: Tri-Sniper
classes.description: 3 piercing cannons. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Independent target acquisition and multi-target penetration.
classes.weaknesses: Automatic split fire limits deliberate finishing bursts.

classes.name: Phantom
classes.description: 1 guided cannon and 2 drone launchers. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Persistent guided pressure from several attack types.
classes.weaknesses: Lost drones and missed shots make rebuilding slow.

classes.name: Spectral Guard
classes.description: 3 guided cannons and 2 barrier launchers. Cannons rotate around the tank.
classes.strengths: Guided rotation and cover create irregular attack lanes.
classes.weaknesses: Side barriers provide little protection directly ahead.

classes.name: Rail Destroyer
classes.description: 1 piercing cannon and 1 shell cannon. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Precision burst attacks with a strong escape cannon.
classes.weaknesses: Both weapons have recovery windows and opposing aim lanes.

classes.name: Five-Way Sniper
classes.description: 5 piercing cannons. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Penetrating radial shots break surrounded formations.
classes.weaknesses: Reloading and radial distribution reduce focused damage.

classes.name: Quad Sprayer
classes.description: 4 scatter cannons.
classes.strengths: Staggered omnidirectional close coverage.
classes.weaknesses: Short reach and distributed damage favor patient long-range opponents.

classes.name: Gunship
classes.description: 2 scatter cannons and 1 turret launcher. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Turret pressure bridges strong close-burst recovery.
classes.weaknesses: Slow emplacement deployment limits pursuit.

classes.name: Octo Sprayer
classes.description: Eight scatter cannons fire around the hull. The front cannon follows your aim.
classes.strengths: Broad coverage for defending space around the tank.
classes.weaknesses: Only part of the volley hits a distant target.

classes.name: Piercing Sprayer
classes.description: A forward spray with a longer piercing cannon down the center.
classes.strengths: The spray covers close targets while the center cannon reaches farther.
classes.weaknesses: Most damage needs close range. The piercing cannon reloads slowly.

classes.name: Starburst
classes.description: 6 explosive cannons.
classes.strengths: Radial area bursts punish groups surrounding it.
classes.weaknesses: Long recovery and dispersed shells create avoidable attack windows.

classes.name: Mine Gunner
classes.description: 1 fragment cannon and 2 mine layers.
classes.strengths: Fragment pressure makes avoiding nearby mine lanes harder.
classes.weaknesses: Slow setup and burst recovery encourage distant engagements.

classes.name: Fortress Array
classes.description: 6 bullet cannons and 4 barrier launchers. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Dense autonomous defense around contested ground.
classes.weaknesses: Slow and dependent on stationary cover; artillery can break the perimeter.

classes.name: Auto Gunner
classes.description: Four forward cannons with an automatic turret.
classes.strengths: Steady forward fire, automatic defense, and allied healing.
classes.weaknesses: Small bullets deal little damage individually.

classes.name: Rotator
classes.description: 8 piercing cannons. Cannons rotate around the tank.
classes.strengths: Rotating long-range penetration denies space in every direction.
classes.weaknesses: Cannot continuously focus all barrels on one opponent.

classes.name: Drone Sentinel
classes.description: 4 bullet cannons and 4 drone launchers. Cannons rotate around the tank.
classes.strengths: Drone pursuit fills the gaps between rotating gun lanes.
classes.weaknesses: Losing its drone screen leaves predictable rotation gaps.

classes.name: Booster
classes.description: One forward cannon and four rear thrusters. Dash to accelerate.
classes.strengths: Rear recoil and Dash help gain speed.
classes.weaknesses: The front cannon has a long reload.

classes.name: Undertow
classes.description: 1 shell cannon and 1 trap launcher.
classes.strengths: A heavy attack and retreating trap screen create asymmetric pressure.
classes.weaknesses: Burst downtime and trap setup make a direct chase difficult.

classes.name: Swarm Commander
classes.description: 3 drone launchers.
classes.strengths: Large staggered formations can envelop exposed targets.
classes.weaknesses: Area attacks can erase an expensive formation.

classes.name: Interceptor
classes.description: 3 drone launchers and 1 piercing cannon. Automatic cannons aim independently. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Interceptors defend while the piercing cannon reloads.
classes.weaknesses: Splitting focus between drones and long-range shots costs efficiency.

classes.name: Palisade
classes.description: 2 drone launchers and 3 barrier launchers. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Layered cover and persistent units defend a forward arc.
classes.weaknesses: Rear flanks and artillery force it to abandon its cover.

classes.name: Fabricator
classes.description: Six armed minions backed by three stationary turrets. Move the squad, then hold the ground.
classes.strengths: The minions move with you while the turrets cover the way back.
classes.weaknesses: Six minions still means six. Turrets cannot come along when you change fronts.

classes.name: Mega Trapper
classes.description: A wide trap cannon launches a concentrated trap volley.
classes.strengths: A dense trap field is difficult to rush.
classes.weaknesses: Traps need time to set up and have poor reach.

classes.name: Quarry
classes.description: 4 mine layers and 1 explosive cannon. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Combines mine territory control with a deliberate artillery threat.
classes.weaknesses: Slow deployment and charging leave brief exposed windows.

classes.name: Bastion
classes.description: 4 turret launchers and 1 barrier launcher.
classes.strengths: Multiple firing positions with team sustain.
classes.weaknesses: Very low pursuit speed and expensive cover replacement.

classes.name: Javelin
classes.description: 2 shell cannons.
classes.strengths: Heavy rear recoil closes gaps and deters pursuit.
classes.weaknesses: No forward gun; a missed contact attack is dangerous.

classes.name: Monolith
classes.description: 2 barrier launchers. Automatic cannons aim independently.
classes.strengths: Exceptional contact resilience and regenerating cover.
classes.weaknesses: Slow and easy to kite; cover is stationary.

classes.name: Meteor
classes.description: 1 explosive cannon.
classes.strengths: Sudden body attacks and an explosive escape wake.
classes.weaknesses: Rear fire gives little help in a stalled frontal engagement.

classes.name: Cluster Destroyer
classes.description: 2 explosive cannons and 1 fragment cannon.
classes.strengths: Layered area attacks break tightly grouped defenses.
classes.weaknesses: Slow projectile travel and low agility favor open-space dodging.

classes.name: Catapult
classes.description: 3 fragment cannons and 1 guided cannon. Automatic cannons aim independently. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Wide fragmenting siege pressure with a defensive escort.
classes.weaknesses: Reloads and slow movement give flankers time to close.

classes.name: Anvil
classes.description: 4 shell cannons.
classes.strengths: Heavy pressure in every cardinal lane and strong surge windows.
classes.weaknesses: Slow movement and distributed guns make focused duels demanding.

classes.name: Gunner
classes.description: Four narrow cannons fire alternating bullets.
classes.strengths: Fast, steady forward fire.
classes.weaknesses: Small bullets are easier to block.

classes.name: Tri-Angle
classes.description: One forward cannon and two angled rear cannons.
classes.strengths: Rear recoil helps movement while firing.
classes.weaknesses: Only one cannon points forward.

classes.name: Auto 3
classes.description: Three automatic turrets mounted around the hull.
classes.strengths: Turrets track nearby enemies without manual aiming.
classes.weaknesses: Each turret is limited to an outward firing arc.

classes.name: Triplet
classes.description: Three forward cannons fire alternating bullets.
classes.strengths: Fast, concentrated forward fire.
classes.weaknesses: Needs accurate tracking and has little rear defense.

classes.name: Hybrid
classes.description: A large shell cannon with a rear drone port.
classes.strengths: Heavy forward shots with supporting drones.
classes.weaknesses: Slow shells and long firing gaps.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.description: A square hull with two opposing drone ports.
classes.strengths: Drones can surround targets and block incoming shots.
classes.weaknesses: Destroyed drones need time to replace.

classes.name: Streamliner
classes.description: Five stacked cannons fire a steady stream of bullets.
classes.strengths: Rapid, focused forward fire.
classes.weaknesses: The narrow firing lane requires accurate aim.

classes.name: Afterburner
classes.description: A front cannon with three rear cannons and a dash.
classes.strengths: Rear fire and Dash help reposition quickly.
classes.weaknesses: Limited forward damage.

classes.name: Crossfire
classes.description: Two pairs of cannons fire in opposite directions.
classes.strengths: Burst fire covers the front and rear.
classes.weaknesses: Only half the guns face one target.

classes.name: Helix
classes.description: 6 bullet cannons. Cannons rotate around the tank.
classes.strengths: Steady aim lane inside a moving defensive curtain.
classes.weaknesses: Much of its damage is spread across the arena.

classes.name: Piercing Cannon
classes.description: 1 piercing cannon. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: Burst pressure through clustered targets.
classes.weaknesses: Narrow shots demand accurate leading.

classes.name: Triple Trapper
classes.description: 3 trap launchers.
classes.strengths: Creates broad, durable approach denial.
classes.weaknesses: Weak against enemies who refuse to approach its traps.

classes.name: Double Burst
classes.description: Front and rear cannons fire three-shot bursts along one axis.
classes.strengths: Burst fire covers the front and rear while you move between targets.
classes.weaknesses: Each burst needs time to reload; the sides stay exposed.

classes.name: Drone Cannon
classes.description: 1 piercing cannon and 1 drone launcher. Hold fire to keep shooting.
classes.strengths: A persistent formation can surround a target.
classes.weaknesses: A lost wave needs time to rebuild.

classes.name: Triple Twin
classes.description: Three pairs of cannons cover three directions.
classes.strengths: Steady fire covers several directions.
classes.weaknesses: Only one pair can focus on a distant target.

classes.name: Overtrapper
classes.description: A trap launcher with a supporting drone port.
classes.strengths: Traps guard a position while drones pursue enemies.
classes.weaknesses: A lost drone group needs time to replace.

classes.name: Battleship
classes.description: Four short drone ports fire from two opposite sides.
classes.strengths: Multiple ports spread out drone launches.
classes.weaknesses: Destroyed drones take time to replace.

classes.name: Auto Smasher
classes.description: An armored rammer with a small automatic cannon.
classes.strengths: Body damage, a shield, and automatic support fire.
classes.weaknesses: The small turret cannot replace close combat.

classes.name: Auto 5
classes.description: Five automatic turrets mounted around the hull.
classes.strengths: Automatic fire covers more directions.
classes.weaknesses: Only the turrets facing a target can engage it.

classes.name: Gunner Trapper
classes.description: Two forward cannons and a rear trap launcher.
classes.strengths: Forward fire and rear traps help during retreat.
classes.weaknesses: Traps are less useful during a chase.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: A single drone spawner with a cloak ability.
classes.strengths: Cloak helps reposition while drones fight.
classes.weaknesses: A destroyed formation takes time to rebuild.

classes.name: Riposte
classes.description: Time your parry to return enemy shots as homing bullets.
classes.strengths: Returns heavy shots and volleys.
classes.weaknesses: Short parry window; modest cannon damage.

classes.name: Counterguard
classes.description: A tighter parry restores health and returns a stronger shot.
classes.strengths: A successful parry heals and returns a heavy countershot.
classes.weaknesses: The timing window is short. Drones bypass the parry.

classes.name: Reprisal
classes.description: A perfect parry returns a three-shot counter volley.
classes.strengths: A landed parry returns the shot and two smaller echoes.
classes.weaknesses: A 0.14-second window leaves little room for error.

classes.name: Fusillade
classes.description: Three cannons fire in a staggered line.
classes.strengths: Steady pressure with small gaps between shots.
classes.weaknesses: A wide nose makes close fights awkward.

classes.name: Longbow
classes.description: A heavy piercing cannon with a rear trap launcher.
classes.strengths: Long firing lanes and a trap to cover retreat.
classes.weaknesses: Reloading exposes the front.

classes.name: Bastille
classes.description: Three forward launchers and a rear trap port.
classes.strengths: Builds a field without leaving the rear open.
classes.weaknesses: Slow movement and a shared trap limit.

classes.name: Commodore
classes.description: Six armed minions and a rear barrier launcher.
classes.strengths: A squad can hold a lane while barriers cover retreat.
classes.weaknesses: The squad takes time to rebuild.

classes.name: Harrier
classes.description: Four ports replace a fast eight-drone squad.
classes.strengths: Mobile control with quick replacements.
classes.weaknesses: Low hull health; losing the squad leaves an opening.

classes.name: Juggernaut
classes.description: A heavy spiked hull with two small support guns.
classes.strengths: The heavy shot can finish a weakened tank.
classes.weaknesses: A missed heavy shot leaves the hull exposed.

classes.name: Mirage
classes.description: Twin guided cannons with a short rear spread.
classes.strengths: Can turn a pursuit around with cloak and rear fire.
classes.weaknesses: Guided rounds can be sidestepped and expire quickly.

classes.name: Rook
classes.description: A turret field with barriers along the firing lane.
classes.strengths: A prepared position is hard to rush.
classes.weaknesses: Slow setup and limited reach.
